title: Reading Comprehension Problem #1
text: Identify the grammatically correct sentence structure or verbal meaning in Reading Comprehension (Case #1):
explanation: Subject-verb agreement: when subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('teachers' -> 'were').

options.text: Neither the principal nor the teachers was present at the convention.
Either the principal and the teachers are absent yesterday.
None of the teacher were attending the seminar.
Neither the principal nor the teachers were present at the convention.
